evidence: jobs/isthmian-canal-1911/output/texts/EO_1246.txt (Sept. 16, 1910): 'Civil Service Rule X, paragraph 8, clause (a), is hereby amended by inserting ... "in cases of transfer from the Isthmus of Panama or"'. Its only content amends a general civil-service rule that operates beyond the Zone, so the Canal Zone event does not reach it; O2a defers to PD-CS-RULES, whose pure-amendment branches apply ruling P2. No later edge held.

jobs/app-executive-orders/output/texts/executive-order-6202-executive-council.txt (July 11, 1933): authority clause cites Public No. 5 (Act of March 31, 1933) and the whole NIRA; appoints a temporary Executive Council, Frank C. Walker as Executive Secretary, and directs the Public Works Administrator (Title II) to allot funds. Public No. 5 is an O1/N6 exclusion; open with another statute's lifecycle needed is right. The EO 6651 sentence in the gaps is family boilerplate, not about this member.

jobs/isthmian-canal-1911/output/texts/EO_665.txt (Aug. 15, 1907): 'Offices for the convenient execution of its business within the United States shall be maintained by the Isthmian Canal Commission in Washington'. Washington office of the Commission, listed under O2 in the .md; open needs 37 Stat. 560. The three later_edges (EO 8724, 1941) cite 'Executive Order No. 665 of the Governor of the Territory of Hawaii, dated October 28, 1935', a different instrument; the lead correctly does not rely on them.

jobs/app-executive-orders/output/texts/executive-order-6207-continuing-effect-the-authority-delegated-the-secretary-agriculture.txt and jobs/hathi-gpo-orders/output/texts/EO_6207.txt (July 21, 1933): the order has no authority clause of its own; the words 'authority vested in me by Title I' that N6's test read are inside the quotation of EO 6182. Its only operative content is that 'Nothing in my Executive Order dated July 15, 1933 ... shall be ... in modification or derogation of' EO 6182 and that EO 6182 'shall ... be and remain in full force and effect'. Later orders cite it as part of its parent ('Executive Order No. 6182 of June 26, 1933, as supplemented by Executive Order No. 6207', e.g. EO 6345, EO 6551 edges). It is a supplement-only order of the kind ruling P2 governs (the doctrine treats EO 7076, a continuing order, the same way in N4), not an independent Title I order that EO 7076 extended. The lead no is right; basis and date follow P2.
correct_lead: no, TERM, merged_into_parent_on_issue, date 1933-07-21 (order date), with the P2 disclosure that its text continues as part of EO 6182 (itself a Title I order ending by 1936-04-01); open pending EO 6182 if the owner takes the P2 alternative.

evidence: jobs/isthmian-canal-1911/output/texts/EO_946.txt (Oct. 3, 1908): 'Schedule A, Subdivision VIII, relating to the Isthmian Canal Commission, is hereby amended ... 2. One inspecting engineer and inspectors in the purchasing department.' Pure amendment of the general Civil Service Rules; O2a deferral to PD-CS-RULES is right. Edge EO 947 is a 'See' cross-reference only.

jobs/app-executive-orders/output/texts/executive-order-6569-complaints-charging-the-pursuit-monopolistic-practices.txt (Jan. 20, 1934): acts 'pursuant to the authority thereby vested in me [Title I] and in accordance with ... an act to create a Federal Trade Commission, approved September 26, 1914'. The Federal Trade Commission Act is an N6 exclusion and the .md lists EO 6569 in O1; open is right.

Member text jobs/app-executive-orders/output/texts/executive-order-3332-retention-hoboken-piers.txt (Oct. 2, 1920; War Department retention of Hoboken piers for two years, pier 1 for the five-year lease). The lead says 'Revoked in full by Executive Order No. 3260, which names this order by number', dated 1922-01-19, with no source. The held EO 3260 (jobs/pinakes-proquest-ingest/output/texts/EO_3260.txt) is dated '17 April, 1920', before EO 3332 existed, and concerns turning over the gasoline launch 'K of P' to the Immigration Service; it does not mention EO 3332. Nothing held supports 1922-01-19. The held later edge SH-eaeebef6504e and the held text jobs/pinakes-proquest-ingest/output/texts/EO_3350.txt show EO 3350 (edge date 1920-11-05; the OCR'd dateline is damaged) re-issuing the retention with different piers and ending: 'Executive Order No. 3332, dated October 2, 1920, directing the retention by the War Department of certain portions of the Hoboken piers, is hereby canceled.' Also inconsistent with its own branch: O2 is an open branch and the gaps are the O2 open boilerplate. The lead no is right on the evidence, but its basis and date are false.
correct_lead: no, ACT, revoked_by_later_order (express cancellation by number), fixed 1920-11-05, source EO 3350 (ProQuest scan text, OCR dateline damaged; date from edge SH-eaeebef6504e).

evidence: jobs/app-executive-orders/output/texts/executive-order-6343-designation-and-authorization-the-secretary-the-interior-acquire.txt (Oct. 18, 1933): 'By virtue of the authority vested in me by title II of the National Industrial Recovery Act'. Title II authority; O1 open is right. The Hathi copy begins with an unrelated Treasury Decision on the same page, then the EO 6343 text agrees.

jobs/pinakes-proquest-ingest/output/texts/EO_3985.txt (April 3, 1924) designates Major Lucius Meriwether Smith special judge; jobs/pinakes-proquest-ingest/output/texts/EO_4006.txt (May 7, 1924): 'The Executive Order No. 3985, dated April 3, 1924, designating Major Lucius Meriwether Smith ... is hereby rescinded'. Express rescission by number; date 1924-05-07 matches the held dateline; scan-text gaps stated.

jobs/isthmian-canal-1911/output/texts/EO_595.txt (Mar. 18, 1907): 'The Order of March 4th is hereby amended so as to provide for Lieutenant-Colonel George W. Goethals ... the use of a furnished dwelling house ... and ... his actual and necessary expenses'. One named person's entitlements; M8 and ruling P4 send it to PD-CS-ONE-PERSON, and the gaps disclose the P2 reading.

jobs/app-executive-orders/output/texts/executive-order-6770-creating-the-industrial-emergency-committee.txt (June 30, 1934): authority is 'the National Industrial Recovery Act' as a whole (no Title I named) plus the Executive Council and National Emergency Council orders; appoints Donald R. Richberg and creates the Industrial Emergency Committee. Listed under O1; open is right. Edge EO 6836 amends paragraph 5 only.

jobs/wikisource-texts/output/texts/EO_1902.txt (Mar. 20, 1914; 36,489 bytes, past the 12,000-character window): rests on sec. 5 of the Panama Canal Act; 'The United States or the Panama Railroad Company shall pay compensation ... for personal injuries'. Panama Railroad employees and continuing injury-compensation rights; O2 open is right. Edges EO 2052 are amendments.

jobs/app-executive-orders/output/texts/executive-order-7192-delegating-authority-the-federal-trade-commission-approve-certain.txt and Hathi copy (Sept. 26, 1935): 'authority vested in me by section 2(a) and section 2(b) of Title I ..., certain provisions of which Title were extended until April 1, 1936, by the Joint Resolution of June 14, 1935 ... I hereby delegate to the Federal Trade Commission all authority'. Only content is a delegation of Title I powers; NIRA sec. 2(c) as amended ends them on 1936-04-01 (P8). Fixed 1936-04-01 is right.

jobs/app-executive-orders/output/texts/executive-order-6515-extension-the-presidents-reemployment-agreement-april-30-1934.txt (Dec. 19, 1933): 'pursuant to the authority vested in me by title I ... and otherwise'; offers the President's Reemployment Agreement 'for a further period of 4 months from January 1, 1934, to April 30, 1934'. The N6 branch and lead no are right, but the interval ends 1943-04-01; EO 7076 (held APP text) extends Title I orders only 'until April 1, 1936', and the lead's own basis quotes that date. Its own offer period ended April 30, 1934 (EO 6678-A, held, April 14, 1934, made a further offer 'in extension of Executive Order No. 6515'), an earlier candidate end not disclosed.
correct_lead: no, ACT, ended_by_express_class_instrument, interval (1933-12-19, 1936-04-01]; disclose the own-terms offer period ending 1934-04-30, extended by EO 6678-A.

evidence: jobs/app-executive-orders/output/texts/executive-order-6785-delegation-authority-the-secretary-the-interior-under-section-9-the.txt (June 30, 1934): 'authority vested in me by section 2 (b) of title I ... I hereby designate ... the Secretary of the Interior to exercise ... all the functions and powers vested in me by subdivisions (a) and (b) of section 9'. Title I order before 1935-06-15; interval (1934-06-30, 1936-04-01] is right. Ruling P8 would give the sharper fixed 1936-04-01, which lies inside the interval.

jobs/wikisource-texts/output/texts/EO_2737.txt (Oct. 24, 1917): 'it is hereby directed that the word "south" be substituted for the word "north"' in EO 2692's description. Only content amends EO 2692; P2 merged on issue, date 1917-10-24; parent EO 2692 revoked as a class by EO 3027 (1919-01-25), disclosed.

jobs/app-executive-orders/output/texts/executive-order-7064-continuing-the-powers-the-administrator-public-works-under-nira.txt (June 7, 1935): 'Pursuant to the authority vested in me by the Emergency Relief Appropriation Act of 1935', continuing Title II functions. Not a Title I order; O1 open is right.

jobs/wikisource-texts/output/texts/EO_1812.txt (Aug. 9, 1913): 'Richard Lee Metcalfe is hereby appointed a member of the Isthmian Canal Commission at the rate of Fourteen Thousand Dollars'. One named person; C1 open under P4 is right.

jobs/app-executive-orders/output/texts/executive-order-6771-abolishing-the-national-recovery-review-board.txt (June 30, 1934): 'the remaining members of the said Board are hereby directed to take the necessary steps to discontinue the said Board prior to July 1, 1934, and it is hereby ordered that the said Board shall cease to exist on that date'. Only command is the abolition; fixed 1934-07-01 is right.

jobs/app-executive-orders/output/texts/executive-order-6463-extension-stay-the-provision-the-cotton-textile-code.txt and Hathi copy (Nov. 27, 1933): 'the above-mentioned Executive orders [of November 6 and November 13, 1933] are hereby modified by extending the termination date of said stay until the completion of said hearings and determination by me'. Its only operative content amends two other orders, so ruling P2 governs it (as N7 does for EO 6612-A), not N6. Its own words also end the stay at the determination after the hearings, an undisclosed own-terms candidate. The lead no is right; N6's ACT basis and the interval (1933-11-27, 1936-04-01], which excludes the P2 date, are not.
correct_lead: no, TERM, merged_into_parent_on_issue, date 1933-11-27, with the P2 disclosure (parents: the orders of Nov. 6 and Nov. 13, 1933 on the Cotton Textile Code stay); open pending the parents under the P2 alternative.

evidence: jobs/wikisource-texts/output/texts/EO_2877.txt (May 31, 1918): 'all law officers of the Government excepting those in the Philippine Islands ... shall exercise their functions under the supervision and control of the head of the Department of Justice', under the Overman Act. jobs/isthmian-canal-1911/output/texts/EO_289.txt (Jan. 5, 1905): 'Section VIII of Schedule A of the Civil Service Rules is hereby amended by adding the following-named positions'. Edge: EO 394 (jobs/isthmian-canal-1911/output/texts/EO_394.txt, Jan. 12, 1906) strikes 'all of the present provisions of Section VIII' and substitutes new text; Wikisource lists it as superseding EO 289. Under P3 that is a whole-text restatement to be disclosed as a candidate end; the gaps do not mention it, a minor omission since PD-CS-RULES decides the member.

jobs/app-executive-orders/output/texts/executive-order-6684-compact-fair-competition-for-the-prison-industries-the-united-states.txt (April 19, 1934): 'pursuant to the authority vested in me by said Compact, and by Title I ..., and otherwise'; approves the Prison Industries Compact, appoints three members of the Prison Labor Authority, and delegates the Compact's powers to the Administrator. jobs/pinakes-proquest-ingest/output/texts/EO_4102A.txt (Nov. 13, 1924): badly garbled scan OCR, legible enough to show the Trading with the Enemy Act of October 6, 1917 and authority for the Alien Property Custodian to approve acts on 'deposits, transfer ... and interest' of moneys deposited with the Treasurer. jobs/app-executive-orders/output/texts/executive-order-6590-b-delegation-authority-administrator-for-industrial-recovery.txt (Feb. 8, 1934): 'authority vested in me under the provisions of Title I ... jobs/isthmian-canal-1911/output/texts/EO_673.txt (Aug. 3, 1907): 'The Executive Order of June 11, 1907, providing for the transfer of Mr. George S. Fox ... is hereby revoked.' Sole content is a revocation; P1 spent on issue, 1907-08-03.
